items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: I was just such a big Elton fan, still am... that's how much I liked him.

ctx.x: But your hipness, the camera liked you.

You know another crazy thing I did that I still can’t really explain but while I was in Hollywood doing that show, the show was kind of about rock musicians. I play myself as a rock musician. And it would end with a musical number every episode. And for the musical number they wanted to kind of flash me up a little bit and they said, “Let’s get you the wardrobe gal, I’ll take you on Sunset Boulevard and get a pair of frames that will work in the number.” And this turned out to be where Elton John got his glasses…
